metadataRaw.title: Unlock a STIFF Back in Seconds
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows to unlock a stiff, achy back in seconds.

This exercise will focus on two separate movements to stretch both the back and the front, and help improve pain-free range of motion.

It requires no equipment, can be done at home, and may give relief within 30 seconds.

Let us know how it works for you!
